subject: using updateTabsetPanel to update active tabs within a module

messages.author: 28f304a5b12956b0
messages.subject: using updateTabsetPanel to update active tabs within a module
parts:
Hi,

I have a shiny app where there is a central navbarPage within which there are tabs named 'Overview' ,'Report1', 'Report2'

Overview tab contains Description text + links to other reports ('Report1','Report2' etc)

All the tabs are in separate shiny modules. i.e. Overview has a different module, Report1 has a different module and so on.

I am facing issues in being able to link to other tabs in Overview Tabs. Overview tab has hyperlinks to 'Report1', 'Report2' etc.
I want the user to navigate to Report1 when he clicks on 'Report1' and so on.

The code I am using to have this functionality within the 'Overview Module' is this:

# 
# Overview: Mapping links to tabs

  observeEvent(input$link_to_Report1,{ # 'link_to_Report1 is the actionLink to 'Report1' defined in the UI part of Overview Module
    newvalue <- "Report1"   #this (Report1) is the 'value' argument of tabpanel 'Report1'
    updateTabsetPanel(session,"navbarpanels", newvalue) # navbarpanels is the id of parent navbarPage
  })





The problem is that the hyperlink is not working. 
I think there is a scoping problem as the above code is in 'Overview' module and it is not able to identify 'navbarpanels' argument in updateTabsetPanel statement since 'navbarpanels' is defined in app.r (parent code).

Any suggestions as to how can I make this hyperlink work would be welcome :)

messages.author: d6ebe55625e8e5a2
messages.subject: Re: using updateTabsetPanel to update active tabs within a module
parts:
You should be using updateNavbarPage() instead of updateTabsetPanel() if you have a navbarPage and not a tabsetPanel.

However, scoping might be a problem too in this example.

Please post a minimal reproducible example if you can.
